card.name: Inside split-up words, mid-spelling
card.fires_on: Fragments in the middle of a longer word that has been broken into pieces, such as 'sa' in 'saith', 'AI' in 'IMPAIRED', or 'GL' in 'NITROGLYCERIN'. The next piece completes the word.

modes.label: Capitalized medical words
modes.description: Pieces inside all-caps warning words like IMPAIRED or NITROGLYCERIN.
modes.example: WITH IMP<<AI>>RED RENAL FUNCTION AND/OR NE

modes.label: Archaic or rare words
modes.description: Opening pieces of old or Latin-style words such as saith, aufert, engrafted.
modes.example: As he<< sa>>ith also in another place, Thou art

modes.label: Hyphenated compounds
modes.description: The piece after a hyphen in a compound like cleared-felled or sharp-shinned.

card.plain: It fires partway through a long or unusual word that is split into pieces, before the word is finished.
